CustomField.description: Data access used by fflib_SObjectSelector subclasses whose constructor does not specify one. LEGACY preserves the behavior prior to API 67 (system mode). When the Default record is missing or this field is blank, USER_MODE is used. The unit of work is not affected; choose its data access with an IDML implementation.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: LEGACY preserves the behavior prior to API 67 (system mode). SYSTEM_MODE and USER_MODE apply native Apex system or user mode.
CustomField.label: Default Data Access
